model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the variation of a metric identified as "ACC (%)" across varying values of "Co-occurrence Number" for six distinct categories. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number," utilizes a logarithmic scale with tick labels indicating values at $10^1$, $10^2$, and $10^3$. The y-axis, labeled "ACC (%)," employs a linear scale with a visible range extending from 40 to 65, featuring major tick marks placed at regular intervals of 5. All data is plotted using solid lines that demonstrate a declining trend across the span of the x-axis. The "Base" line is black with circle markers, starting around an ACC value of 43 at the lowest plotted x-value and steadily decreasing to approximately 34 at the highest recorded x-value. The "FT" line is blue with downward-pointing triangle markers, commencing near 45.5 and following a downward trajectory to end at roughly 37. The "IKE" line is red with upward-pointing triangle markers, beginning near 49 and dropping progressively across each data point to finish at about 38. The "MEND" line is brown with diamond markers, starting near 50, decreasing gradually at first, and then dropping to end at approximately 41.5. The "MEMIT" line is purple with pentagon markers, initiating around 49.5 and concluding at roughly 40.5. The "ROME" line is green with square markers, starting at approximately 55.5 and exhibiting a gradual, continuous decline to finish near a value of 49.
